description: Edit an existing offer without changing its checkout link. Set checkout copy with checkout (REPLACES all existing blocks; pass every field to keep, or null to reset). To add, replace or remove order bumps, call list_offers first and copy that offer's bumps_rev; then pass bumps as the COMPLETE ordered list of up to three one-time products (or [] to remove all). Omit bumps to preserve them. A stale bumps_rev is refused so another person's edit is not overwritten. Each bump needs its own delivery. This also sets a per-offer checkout_logo_url and edits post-purchase step copy with upsell_* or funnel_steps. CART OFFERS: items and discount_rule have their own REPLACE semantics; carts cannot carry bumps.

bumps.description: Complete ordered replacement of checkout bumps. [] clears; omission preserves. One-time single offers only.

bumps_rev.description: Required with bumps. Read the current value from list_offers immediately before editing.

accent.description: Brand hex colour; light shades rejected (button text is white)

bullets.description: Benefits, not features — what the buyer GETS

choice_offer_ids.description: Explicit same-account offers for Plan picker, Comparison or Inline offers. Only currently live single offers in the same currency are displayed. Each opens its own checkout.

deadline.description: ISO datetime; renders an HONEST countdown that disappears when passed and never resets. Only set real deadlines.

design.description: Choose a structural layout from the 20-design library. Independent of colours. Null restores the classic layout.

body.description: Specific beats vague: state exactly what happens on refund

headline.description: Outcome-focused headline, e.g. 'Launch your course in 30 days' — not the product name

image_url.description: Brand/course BANNER image. Renders full-width at the top of the story column (or, in the 'hero' layout, as a full-width banner across the whole checkout). Width-driven — use a WIDE image; height follows naturally, so exact height doesn't matter.

layout.description: Checkout template: 'standard' = story+price left, form right (default, best all-rounder); 'compact' = single narrow column for quick buys; 'hero' = full-width image banner on top (needs image_url), two columns below

page_color.description: Page background colour for the design library

sections.description: Story sections, lesson outline or purchase details

surface_color.description: Panel background colour; text contrast adapts

testimonials.description: REAL testimonials only — fabricating them violates the acceptable use policy

video_url.description: Direct video file for Cinema, without autoplay

checkout_logo_url.description: Logo at the very TOP of this offer's checkout (~46px tall), overriding the account logo — for per-offer / per-brand logos. HTTPS only.

discount_rule.description: Cart offers only: REPLACE the bundle discount rule; null removes it

funnel_steps.description: Per-step copy edits for a multi-step funnel. Position 1 and the top-level upsell_* fields write the same step.

position.description: Which step to edit: 1 = first upsell, 2 = downsell, 3 = second upsell

items.description: Cart offers only: REPLACE the cart's items (2–10 one-time products, one currency)

project.description: Set/replace the offer project label for grouping; empty string clears it. Reuse existing names exactly (see list_offers).

upsell_body.description: Upsell page body copy (aliases funnel step 1)

upsell_button_label.description: Upsell accept-button text, e.g. 'Yes — add the coaching call' (aliases funnel step 1)

upsell_decline_label.description: Upsell decline-link text, e.g. 'No thanks, I'll pass' (aliases funnel step 1)

name: update_checkout
title: Customize a checkout
